title: Test-Time Symmetrization: Scaling Laws for Model-Agnostic Learning under Structure
abstract: arXiv:2611.24032v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time compute has emerged as a powerful way to improve the accuracy of language models at inference time, with scaling laws quantifying how accuracy improves with additional forward passes. Existing scaling laws, however, focus on repeated sampling from a fixed prompt, even though many tasks admit multiple equivalent representations of the same underlying problem. A graph does not depend on how its nodes are numbered, and a program does not depend on the names of its variables, yet language models can change their answers under such rewritings. In this paper, we study test-time symmetrization, which uses forward passes on rewritings of the input and aggregates the resulting answers over the group $G$ of rewritings. We prove that no amount of sampling and repeated decoding from a single representation can replace rewriting, while only $O(\log |G|)$ random rewritings suffice to recover the information provided by all $|G|$ rewritings.

translated_title: 测试时对称化：结构下模型无关学习的缩放定律
translated_abstract: 测试时计算已成为在推理阶段提升语言模型准确性的强大手段，缩放定律定量描述了准确率如何随着额外前向传递次数的增加而提高。然而，现有的缩放定律都聚焦于对固定提示进行重复采样，尽管许多任务对同一底层问题存在多种等价表示。图不依赖于其节点的编号方式，程序也不依赖于其变量的命名，但语言模型在这些重写下可能会改变其答案。在本文中，我们研究了测试时对称化方法，即对输入的重写版本进行前向传递，并在重写群 $G$ 上聚合所得到的答案。我们证明，从单一表示出发的任何数量的采样和重复解码都无法替代重写，而仅需 $O(\log |G|)$ 次随机重写就足以恢复全部 $|G|$ 个重写所提供的信息。
tldr: 该论文提出测试时对称化方法，通过对输入的等价重写进行前向传递并在重写群上聚合答案，证明了单一表示下的重复采样无法替代重写，且仅需 O(log|G|) 次随机重写即可恢复全部 |G| 个重写所蕴含的信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes test-time symmetrization, which aggregates answers over equivalent input rewritings, proving that repeated sampling from a single representation can never replace rewriting, and that only O(log|G|) random rewritings suffice to recover the information provided by all |G| rewritings.
